title: Altaf Hussain University at Hyderabad Amendment Act 2017

sections.shortTitle: Altaf Hussain University at Hyderabad Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 2017
ACT XII
OF 2017
ALTAF
HUSSAIN UNIVERSITY AT HYDERABAD (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Altaf
Hussain University at Hyderabad Act, 2014
[Gazette
of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 12th April, 2017]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-12/2017, dated
12.4.2017.---The Altaf Hussain
University at Hyderabad (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th March, 2017 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 08th April,
2017 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS
it is expedient to amend the Altaf Hussain University at Hyderabad Act, 2014, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Altaf Hussain
University at Hyderabad (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
